lines: Last night, sixty-seven volunteers crawled out into no man's land.
Thirty-five Hegemony. Thirty-two Concord. Over a thousand yards of new wire.
Sixteen were hit out on the wire. Their names are in the Gazette.
At dawn, the last shells from Verdel Ridge came down on the Hegemony, and tore much of the new wire apart again.
Without the wiring parties, almost nothing would be left.
Seventy-one men hit by morning. Nine fell, all of them Hegemony.
Hill 304. Hegemony ninety-seven. Three more, and the hill is theirs.
Three hundred and seventy soldiers hold the front now. Comment Concord or Hegemony to join them.
Mud and Iron. Every follower is a soldier.
